e: IAM Identity Center provides SSO across all Organizations accounts, and connecting it through AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory with a two-way forest trust to the self-managed AD lets the company keep managing users and groups on premises. Creating a separate AD alone, or a trust without Identity Center, gives no multi-account SSO.

Aurora I/O-Optimized has no per-I/O charges and gives predictable price and better performance for I/O-intensive, high-traffic workloads, making it the most cost-effective choice as load grows. Standard storage bills every I/O request, and Provisioned IOPS or General Purpose are not Aurora storage configurations.

AWS Security Hub with a delegated administrator account aggregates findings across all accounts and continuously checks the environment against standards such as NIST SP 800-53 and PCI DSS, giving auditors evidence of control state. Inspector, GuardDuty, and CloudTrail don't provide compliance standards.

S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between access tiers as access patterns change, cutting cost for randomly accessed data while keeping frequently accessed objects immediately available, with no analysis or retrieval charges. Glacier or manual Standard-IA rules would add retrieval fees or delays.

Amazon Neptune is a graph database designed for highly connected data; traversing mutual connections up to five levels is efficient with graph queries, whereas SQL JOINs over millions of relationships become slow.

An AWS Site-to-Site VPN is quick to set up, encrypted, and inexpensive for low bandwidth traffic. Direct Connect takes weeks and costs more, Client VPN is for individual users, and a bastion host isn't a network connection.

AWS Transfer Family offers a managed SFTP endpoint that writes to S3 and can authenticate against Active Directory through the AWS Directory Service option, keeping the same credentials and access mechanisms with the least overhead. Self-managed SFTP servers need operations, and S3 File Gateway uses SMB rather than SFTP. Note: option C names AD Connector, which Transfer Family doesn't support as an identity source, so D is the better fit.

An EventBridge event bus with a rule per validation step keeps components loosely coupled, and the input transformer passes each Lambda target only the subset of the order event it needs. SNS body filtering selects whole messages rather than fields, and the SQS options need extra transformation code.

Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ and read replicas lets the real-time reports run against the reader endpoint, so they don't slow down writes (new entries) on the primary. Reader replicas, not the standby, serve reads, and DynamoDB or a bigger EC2 instance doesn't isolate the reporting load.

A public virtual interface on Direct Connect reaches S3's public endpoints over the private Direct Connect link without using the internet, with no extra VPC or endpoint charges. NAT gateways, interface endpoints, and peering add cost, and VPC peering can't connect to on premises.

A Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy with health checks returns multiple healthy endpoints and stops returning records for unhealthy ones, so traffic is spread across both Regions and avoids a failed Region. Simple routing has no health checks, and an ALB can't have targets in another Region.

Amazon EFS is a shared file system that can be mounted concurrently by many EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones, handles large files, and removes the need to copy files between instances. EBS volumes are AZ-bound, and instance store is ephemeral.

Enabling EBS encryption and RDS encryption with KMS keys encrypts the data at rest with minimal infrastructure changes. ACM certificates and SSL protect data in transit, not volumes, and CloudHSM is more involved.

An S3 gateway endpoint in the VPC, with the subnet route tables updated, sends S3 traffic over the AWS network without going through the internet or the NAT instance, removing the saturation, at no charge. A NAT gateway, larger NAT instance, or transit gateway still route over the internet or add cost.

AWS Global Accelerator brings reporters' traffic onto the AWS global network at the nearest edge location, accelerating TCP connections (such as RTMP) to the broadcast system. CloudFront is for content delivery, and Client VPN or Elastic IPs don't accelerate connections.

EBS Snapshots Archive is a low-cost tier for snapshots kept for 90 days or more, and a policy (Data Lifecycle Manager) can move monthly snapshots there for 7 years with minimal administration. Snapshots in the standard tier for 7 years cost much more, and Glacier copies or direct APIs add effort.

AWS Backup can create a plan with a daily rule that backs up the EFS file system and copies the backup to another Region, a managed and cost-effective way to protect the data cross-Region. Scripts, S3 replication, or rsync over peering are self-managed.

An Auto Scaling group across two AZs behind an ALB gives scalable, highly available web servers, and RDS for SQL Server with Multi-AZ gives a managed, highly available database with the least administration. Self-managed databases on EC2 or a single web instance add overhead or risk.

An AWS Storage Gateway (S3 File Gateway) presents an SMB file share on premises with a local cache for low latency and copies the files to AWS over the existing VPN, with no application changes. EFS, FSx, or Snowball don't provide that local low-latency SMB share.

A scheduled Lambda function (EventBridge schedule) scans the 15-row DynamoDB table and sends email through SNS, which supports email, with no servers to manage. EC2 cron jobs need an instance, and SQS can't send email.

A recurring scheduled scaling action raises capacity before the known holiday spike, so the Auto Scaling group is proactive rather than waiting for a CPU alarm. Alarms are reactive, and changing min and max or SNS alerts don't pre-scale at the right time.

AWS Secrets Manager stores the database credentials and has built-in automatic rotation for RDS PostgreSQL with managed Lambda rotation functions, so rotation needs almost no custom work. Parameter Store has no native rotation, and KMS key rotation doesn't rotate database passwords.

RDS Custom for Oracle supports BYOL and gives privileged access to the OS and database for customizations that third-party features need, while still automating much of the administration, avoiding a costly rewrite. RDS for Oracle doesn't allow that access, and migrating to DynamoDB or PostgreSQL means major rework.

AWS Backup centralizes and automates backup policies, scheduling, and monitoring for EC2/EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, and other services, replacing the custom scripts. Tape gateway, Config, or Systems Manager State Manager aren't backup management services.

Neptune is a managed graph database suited to mapping relationships among infrastructure resources and quickly querying them (for example with SPARQL or Gremlin) to find security risks, with low operational overhead. Relational, warehouse, or key-value stores handle highly connected queries poorly.
